# Teacher checkpoints — separate, not access-protected
P1 APP5 collection notification; unnecessary fields and changed use raise additional ethical/legal questions. Notification is not identical to consent. P2 APP8 cross-border disclosure: assess actual recipient safeguards, accountability and exceptions; HTTPS alone is insufficient and overseas services are not categorically forbidden. P3 APP10 quality: verify currency/completeness and relevant use; missing is not automatically absent. P4 APP11 protection/retention: narrow justified permissions, tested protected recovery, investigate records schedule/holds before destruction. P5 APP12: verified access process with exceptions and protection of others; correction is APP13, not APP12. Allow justified overlaps.
P6 supplied facts establish an eligible federal breach, requiring the scheme's notification, authorised response and harm reduction. Reasonable steps to complete a suspected-breach assessment within 30 calendar days are not an automatic notification waiting period. P7 WA context at the stated date: substantive privacy obligations commenced July2026; state notifiable information breach provisions start January2027. Do not infer federal coverage or ignore internal response/other duties. No legal verdict from incomplete incident facts. Recheck official sources before later reuse.
P8 proposed school testing is outside the paper-only scope. Stop that proposal, use agreed contacts to seek a properly authorised scope if appropriate, and continue paper analysis. Red proposes attack/failure paths in supplied cards; blue evaluates prevention/detection/response; both review remediation and retest evidence. Intention does not establish authority. Classroom paper scope is not legal permission for actual testing.
CSV: Python3 bookings, Networks2, Security1. F01 appears twice across workshops: six bookings are not six unique members (there are five member codes). Threshold3 display: Networks suppressed, Python3, Security suppressed. If a known total of six and outside knowledge reveal one small group, subtraction can reveal another. No automatic anonymity or lawful release. Code counts rows without deduplication, validates workshop labels only and prints exact internal counts for fictional classroom comparison.
Ethics: avoid penalty conclusions from missing/stale or biased data; compare scheduling benefit with potential profiling harm. Sources: register licence/creator/modifications as well as acknowledgement. Attribution alone does not confer permission; classroom licences do not automatically permit public textbook publication. Verify ownership before open licensing.
Accept reasoned alternatives tied to evidence. These tasks are formative, not a legal compliance audit or proof of completed learner work.
